run_optimal_batch_size_finder: run the optimal batch size finder tool to find the best batch size for pose estimation models
run_power_scaling_pose: run power scaling to find optimal batch size by doubling until OOM error is encountered
inference_detector: run object detection inference on images using a detector model with configurable test pipeline
prep_batch_inference_topdown: prepare batch data for top-down pose estimator inference with bounding boxes and images
plot_batch_performance: plot batch size versus seconds per image and FPS with error bars for performance analysis
